item.title: In Car MP3 Player
item.description:
Got myself an in car MP3 player, you can either plug in the iPod etc or a USB drive or SD card with your tracks on it, which it then plays through the car’s radio.

In-Car 12v MP3 FM Modulator and Memory2Go Orbit 360 2GB USB2.0 Flash Drive combined to make the drive to and from work more bearable.

Not bad for £17 including postage.
